caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a curved, ornate door handle or knocker rendered in gold and brown tones. The object is shown in three different views: a three-quarters perspective on the left, a front view on the right, and a smaller cross-sectional side view above the front view, which includes a scale in inches ranging from 0 to 4. The handle is attached to circular mounting plates at both ends, and its surface is shaded to emphasize depth and highlighted to suggest a metallic sheen. The handle exhibits decorative contours and grooves along its length, and at each end, the mounting plates are circular with raised, concentric designs. The background is a plain light beige, and the name "JANET RIZA" appears at the bottom right of the image.
title: Door Knocker
